title: ng generate @dmaster/ui:theme
description: Scaffolds a custom @dmaster/ui theme (CSS) and wires it into angular.json.

name.description: Theme name — the file name and, in --named mode, the data-dm-theme value.
name.x-prompt: What name should the theme have? (e.g. brand, midnight)

project.description: Workspace project to add the theme to. Defaults to the first application.

primary.description: Seed brand color as a #rrggbb hex. The rest derives from it via the OKLCH cascade.

named.description: Generate a switchable named theme (data-dm-theme) instead of a global recolor.

scheme.description: Base scheme for a named theme (drives color-scheme and the light/dark toggle).

path.description: Directory for the generated theme file. Defaults to the project source root.

skipImport.description: Do not add the generated theme CSS to angular.json.
